profile.headline: Engineering Software Developer at Lester Building Systems, LLC

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
- Providing consultation services to construction contractors for  operations and sales.  

- Residential construction projects including interior remodeling & painting, window and door replacement, and siding installation.

positions.title: Production Manager
positions.description:
- Created estimates for residential insurance claims and remodels
- Scheduled and managed labor, materials, building permits & inspections, debris removal
- Performed all accounting functions including billing, job costing, expense tracking, account reconciliation, payroll, 1099, insurance audits
- Created CAD drawings to obtain building permits.

positions.title: Operations / Purchasing Manager
positions.description:
- Managed all IT functions
- Managed all office personnel
- Continued and improved vendor relationships
- Created estimates for residential insurance claims and remodels
- Scheduled and managed labor, materials, building permits & inspections, debris removal
- Performed all accounting functions including billing, job costing, expense tracking, account reconciliation, payroll, 1099, insurance audits
- Created CAD drawings to obtain building permits.

positions.title: Production Coordinator
positions.description:
- Managed metal shop throughput of storefront glazing division
- Managed logistics of retail, distribution and service work volume
- Engineered shop production processes
- Assisted a manufacturing engineer
- Tracked production progress and provided weekly reports
- Operated CAD/CAM software and digitizer for processing custom glass shapes to be cut and edged by NC and CNC machinery
- Coordinated with all departments to prepare for and count year end inventory
